Container.Name: Cleanarr
Container.Overview: Cleanarr is a web app for getting disk back from your Radarr and Sonarr library. It shows every title you have, who watched it, and who requested it, using Tautulli, Tracearr, or Jellystat for play history and Seerr for requests. Sort by size, age, rating, or last watch, protect the ones you want to keep, and delete the ones nobody is watching, files included. The same screens work on a desktop browser and on a phone.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: radarr sonarr seerr overseerr jellyseerr tautulli jellyfin plex emby tracearr jellystat disk cleanup unwatched
Container.Requires: A Radarr or Sonarr library, plus Tautulli, Tracearr, or Jellystat for watch history. Seerr is optional.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Container port for the Cleanarr web UI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, poster cache, and the generated session secret.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns /data. Unraid nobody is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns /data. Unraid users is 100.

Config.Name: Hide service settings
Config.Description: Set to 1 to hide service URLs, API keys, and login from Settings. Leave at 0 to configure everything in the web UI.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Optional. Locks the login username from the environment. Leave blank to create the account in the web UI on first launch.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. Locks the login password from the environment. Leave blank to create the account in the web UI on first launch.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Optional signing secret. Leave blank and Cleanarr stores a random secret in Appdata.
